STORIES.headline: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to bad weather
STORIES.summary: Officials have postponed the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade because of inclement weather.
article: Officials have postponed the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade because of inclement weather. The parade will be held on Saturday, with Mayor Zohran Mamdani confirming the decision was made jointly with Macy's and city agencies.

The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed as strong winds are expected in New York during the event, according to NBC. The city, Macy’s, and NBC jointly announced the parade’s move to Saturday for safety reasons amid extreme weather. NBC will air a rerun of the 2025 parade on Thursday instead of the original Thanksgiving Day broadcast.
STORIES.imageAlt: A huge balloon depicting Minnie Mouse floats above a crowd of people in a parade, surrounded by skyscrapers in the New York cityscape.

STORIES.headline: Army calls detonation of bomb chemicals in Iowa a success after earlier fears of a toxic plume
STORIES.summary: Earthen barriers and water/foam were used to contain the blast at two bunkers holding 5 tons of lead azide, with officials saying these measures absorbed most of the explosion's impact.
article: Earthen barriers and water/foam were used to contain the blast at two bunkers holding 5 tons of lead azide, with officials saying these measures absorbed most of the explosion's impact. EPA air monitors detected no lead in the air around the plant, and a cellphone alert advised residents it was safe to resume normal activities.

Videos showed a smoke plume rising hundreds of feet and drifting south before dissipating quickly. The Army confirmed all barrels were destroyed without secondary explosions or damage to infrastructure.

STORIES.headline: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies at 65
STORIES.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of Duran Duran, has died at 65, known for hits like 'Hungry Like the Wolf' and 'The Reflex' that helped launch MTV.
article: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of Duran Duran, has died at 65, known for hits like 'Hungry Like the Wolf' and 'The Reflex' that helped launch MTV. Taylor's family and bandmates confirmed his death on social media and the band's official website, stating he was 65. His guitar work and dry wit helped shape the band’s global sound and grounded their music during their rise to fame.

Taylor died peacefully at home on Monday, following a long battle with prostate cancer, according to a statement from the band. Duran Duran said Andy was a foundational member, present from the band’s very beginning.
STORIES.imageAlt: Andy Taylor is photographed in dark glasses speaking into a microphone

STORIES.headline: US approves SpaceX plan to deploy one million data centre satellites
STORIES.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission authorized SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites designed to function as data centers in orbit.
article: The US Federal Communications Commission authorized SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites designed to function as data centers in orbit. The FCC's approval marks the first such authorization in US history, enabling SpaceX to build its Starmind constellation for processing large-scale data on Earth. Spacex's plan to place AI-powered data centers in space aims to meet rising demand for computing power driven by artificial intelligence.

The Trump administration approved SpaceX’s deployment of 1 million satellites intended to serve as space-based data centers, sparking scientific skepticism and concern. SpaceX’s orbital compute modules, part of the 'Starmind' constellation, will process vast data volumes for Earth-based use, with Chairman Brendan Carr stating the move brings humanity closer to harnessing solar power. The FCC’s detailed order requires SpaceX to deploy at least one space station by 2033, with incremental additions planned through 2040.
STORIES.imageAlt: SpaceX Starship Ship 42 is caught in the arms of the launch tower as it returns from flight on November 14, 2026 in Starbase, Texas.

STORIES.headline: What are king tides? These exceptionally high tides are increasingly flooding coastal communities
STORIES.summary: King tides, the highest tides of the year, are increasingly flooding coastal areas as sea levels rise.
article: King tides, the highest tides of the year, are increasingly flooding coastal areas as sea levels rise. The term 'king tide' is a colloquial term used to describe exceptionally high tides, not a scientific phenomenon. The 2026 super El Niño event has elevated coastal water levels and intensified king tide impacts. Oceanographer Alec Bogdanoff explains that tides vary by location, making the definition of a king tide complex and location-specific.

King tides combined with powerful waves damaged part of a pier in Pacifica, Northern California, on Wednesday, with officials warning of further coastal flooding. A video captured a large wave destroying a section of the Pacifica pier and hurling it into the ocean. Beachfront properties in Pacifica, south of San Francisco, began experiencing flooding as king tides arrived this week.
STORIES.imageAlt: What are king tides? These exceptionally high tides are increasingly flooding coastal communities

STORIES.headline: At least 31 killed in fire after fuel tanker crash on Cairo highway
STORIES.summary: A fuel tanker crash on Cairo's ring road ignited a massive fire, killing at least 31 people and injuring 21 others, according to Egyptian authorities.
article: A fuel tanker crash on Cairo's ring road ignited a massive fire, killing at least 31 people and injuring 21 others, according to Egyptian authorities. A fire on Cairo's ring road injured at least 21 people and destroyed over two dozen vehicles and motorcycles, as reported by the health ministry.

A fuel truck overturned on a busy highway in Cairo, sparking a fire that killed at least 31 people, the health ministry confirmed. Footage from AFP showed a massive fireball and thick smoke over Cairo's Al-Waraq area, with residents fleeing as surrounding buildings remained unharmed.
STORIES.imageAlt: People stand next to the wreck of a car in the aftermath of a fire that broke out on a highway in the Al-Waraq neighbourhood of Imbaba district, Giza Governorate, Cairo.

STORIES.headline: Do you work for Poundland? Tell us how you’re affected by its administration
STORIES.summary: Poundland has gone into administration, putting 12,000 jobs at risk as it faces collapse in the run-up to Christmas.
article: Poundland has gone into administration, putting 12,000 jobs at risk as it faces collapse in the run-up to Christmas.

Poundland collapsed into administration after failed rescue efforts, risking around 11,000 jobs and 600 stores ahead of Christmas. The company’s board appointed administrators after a three-month sale effort failed to find a viable buyer for the business. Owner Gordon Brothers stated that talks with potential buyers for the full business or parts of its store assets will continue under administration. The collapse occurs just 17 months after Gordon Brothers bought Poundland from Pepco Group for £1, following months of closures and growing political criticism over management.
STORIES.imageAlt: Do you work for Poundland? Tell us how you’re affected by its administration

STORIES.headline: China’s Huawei convicted of stealing US trade secrets
STORIES.summary: A US federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including trade secret theft and bank fraud, amid allegations of deception about its Iran operations.
article: A US federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including trade secret theft and bank fraud, amid allegations of deception about its Iran operations. Huawei and its subsidiaries were found guilty by a Brooklyn jury on 10 of 12 counts, including conspiracy to steal trade secrets and defraud US banks. Huawei was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy, which accused it of operating as a criminal enterprise.
A federal jury convicted Huawei and its subsidiaries of violating US sanctions on Iran, stealing trade secrets, and engaging in money laundering.
STORIES.imageAlt: China’s Huawei convicted of stealing US trade secrets

STORIES.headline: 1Password breach exposes customer names and emails, but not passwords
STORIES.summary: 1Password confirmed a hacker breached its internal systems on November 19 via an employee's corporate GitHub account, pushing malicious code to servers.
article: 1Password confirmed a hacker breached its internal systems on November 19 via an employee's corporate GitHub account, pushing malicious code to servers. Customer names, email addresses, account creation dates, and login timestamps were stolen, but passwords in vaults remained inaccessible and app functionality is unaffected. It remains unclear how the attacker accessed the employee's account, and 1Password has not yet responded to questions about the breach details. The company has not disclosed whether it notified affected customers or how many were impacted, though it serves millions of users and over 200,000 businesses.

1Password reported that a hacker accessed backend systems and stole customer names and email addresses. The attacker used the compromised account to access source code and inject malicious code into backend services to extract customer data.

STORIES.headline: Unclassified CIA system breached in cyberattack
STORIES.summary: A CIA system used to review open-source information was compromised in a security breach, according to a source familiar with the matter.
article: A CIA system used to review open-source information was compromised in a security breach, according to a source familiar with the matter. A system analyzing publicly available data from online searches, public records, and data brokers was breached, exposing unclassified intelligence material.

Hackers infiltrated unclassified intelligence-analysis systems across multiple US agencies, extracting open-source data without compromising classified information; Chinese involvement is under investigation, with ARTEX platform suspected. Multiple US officials confirmed that attackers accessed an open-source intelligence network, harvesting publicly available data to build actionable intelligence narratives.
STORIES.imageAlt: Unclassified CIA system breached in cyberattack

STORIES.headline: Pentagon reportedly in talks with GM, Ford to scale US military drone production
STORIES.summary: Defense officials are exploring partnerships with automakers and parts suppliers like Magna International to supply drone components such as motors and sensors, according to people familiar with the matter.
article: Defense officials are exploring partnerships with automakers and parts suppliers like Magna International to supply drone components such as motors and sensors, according to people familiar with the matter. No deals have been finalized, and industry executives have raised concerns about profit margins and the viability of entering the weapons supply chain.

These preliminary talks are part of a broader strategy to use the automotive sector’s manufacturing expertise to meet defense supply demands. GM is considering producing drone motors, while other manufacturers may supply parts to existing drone companies, as reported by The Wall Street Journal.
STORIES.imageAlt: Pentagon reportedly in talks with GM, Ford to scale US military drone production

STORIES.headline: Euclid's Record-Setting Quasar Probes Black Hole Formation
STORIES.summary: The ESA's Euclid Space Telescope has detected a quasar at redshift z=8.13, forming about 630 million years after the Big Bang.
article: The ESA's Euclid Space Telescope has detected a quasar at redshift z=8.13, forming about 630 million years after the Big Bang. This quasar is 40 million years older than the previous record holder, advancing understanding of early black hole formation.

Four months after its previous discovery, Euclid has found a quasar even farther back in time, setting a new record. Researchers have published a discovery of the most distant quasar ever seen, dated to just 630 million years after the Big Bang.
STORIES.imageAlt: Astronomers discover oldest known quasar forming 630 million years after the Big Bang
